comment: Test build only (package.ps1 -TestIdentity ships this next to OmniAPI-Test.exe as shell.config.json). Shares nothing with the released app: port 7939 (the test shell refuses 7788), data home %USERPROFILE%\.omniapi-test (it refuses .omniapi), works under that data home (never Documents\OmniAPI), the logon switch on the settings page writes Run\OmniAPI-Test, the settings page's 'connect Claude Code' writes a stand-in claude.json in the data home (never ~/.claude.json), no new-version check, and the service runs offline with fake providers. Installer tests replace this file with their own config (temp data home, test port).
